title: Demon Slayer — complete skill frame set
source: maplestory.io, GMS version 270 (skillbook API; WZ API for 5th/6th-job paths/metadata)

skills.name: Shadow Swiftness
skills.description: Permanently increases Speed, Jump, and Max Speed.

skills.name: HP Boost
skills.description: Permanently increases Max HP.

skills.name: Demon Lash
skills.description: Mash the attack key to whip enemies in front of you 4 times with dark power. Hits return some Fury to you.

skills.name: Agile Demon
skills.description: Increases Attack Speed and Strength.

skills.name: Grim Scythe
skills.description: Summon a demonic scythe that tears through multiple enemies in front of you.

skills.name: Demon Lash
skills.description: Mash the attack key to whip enemies in front of you 4 times with dark power. Hits return some Fury to you.

skills.name: Demon Lash
skills.description: Mash the attack key to whip enemies in front of you 4 times with dark power. Hits return some Fury to you.

skills.name: Demon Lash
skills.description: Mash the attack key to whip enemies in front of you 4 times with dark power. Hits return some Fury to you.

skills.name: Weapon Mastery
skills.description: Increases One-Handed Blunt and Axe Mastery and Final Damage

skills.name: Physical Training
skills.description: Permanently increases STR and DEX.

skills.name: Outrage
skills.description: Permanently increases ATT and Critical Rate.

skills.name: Barbed Lash
skills.description: Increases the damage of Demon Lash.

skills.name: Soul Eater
skills.description: Snares and pulls multiple enemies towards you, where they suffer the full force of your might.

skills.name: Dark Thrust
skills.description: Charge forward with terrifying rage, dragging multiple unfortunate enemies with you. Can be resisted by some monsters.

skills.name: Chaos Lock
skills.description: Targets and attacks the enemy closest to you. Has a chance to stun the enemy. Allows you to teleport in any direction using the directional keys, and also while in the air.

skills.name: Vengeance
skills.description: Reduces incoming damage from enemies for a period of time. Not affected by cooldown reset effects or buff duration increases.

skills.name: Black-Hearted Strength
skills.description: Increases DEF, Abnormal Status Resistance, and Elemental Resistances.

skills.name: Insult to Injury
skills.description: Increase Final Damage when attacking enemies in Stun, Blind, Freeze, Slow, or Incapacitation status. Permanently increases Critical Rate.

skills.name: Focused Fury
skills.description: Focus powers to permanently increase Final Damage and improve Attack Speed by 1 level.

skills.name: Possessed Aegis
skills.description: Grants the Demon Aegis a chance to guard against enemy attacks. If it succeeds, you will recover a small amount of Fury and HP.

skills.name: Max Fury
skills.description: Allows you to gain additional Fury when using Demon Lash, and recovers a fixed amount of Fury every 4 seconds.

skills.name: Demon Lash Arch
skills.description: Increases the damage of Demon Lash.

skills.name: Judgment
skills.description: Judge your enemies...harshly. This attack hits multiple nearby enemies, dealing critical damage with a chance for additional critical hits.

skills.name: Vortex of Doom
skills.description: Creates a vortex of dark energy inside you that draws nearby enemies into your attack and stuns them. Can be resisted by some monsters.

skills.name: Raven Storm
skills.description: Summons a flock of really angry ravens that peck the faces off of any enemies in front of you. The ravens then return the enemies' HP to you as thanks for letting them take out their aggression.

skills.name: Carrion Breath
skills.description: Summons the power of the Poison Demon's horrible breath to attack multiple enemies at once. Targets take continual damage over a short time and are unable to eat lunch for a week afterwards.

skills.name: Barricade Mastery
skills.description: Makes you a master of melee. Maxes out the Mastery of One-Handed Blunt and Axe type weapons while increasing Critical Damage and Attack Power.

skills.name: Obsidian Skin
skills.description: Permanently fortify your defensive abilities so that you take less damage from enemies.

skills.name: Demon Thrash
skills.description: Increases the damage of Demon Lash.

skills.name: Demon Lash - Fury
skills.description: Increases Fury absorbed by Demon Lash.

skills.name: Demon Lash - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Demon Lash's damage.

skills.name: Demon Lash - Spread
skills.description: Increases the max number of enemies hit by Demon Lash.

skills.name: Dark Metamorphosis - Enhance
skills.description: When Dark Metamorphosis activates, damage over time and all of Demon Slayer's attacks will negate Attack Ignore and Attack Reflect effects.\nRight-click to lock activation effect.

skills.name: Dark Metamorphosis - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of Dark Metamorphosis.

skills.name: Dark Metamorphosis - Reduced Fury
skills.description: Reduces the Fury cost of Dark Metamorphosis.

skills.name: Demon Impact - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Demon Impact's damage.

skills.name: Demon Impact - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases the number of attacks for Demon Impact.

skills.name: Demon Impact - Reduce Fury
skills.description: Reduces  the Fury cost of Demon Impact.

skills.name: Infernal Concussion
skills.description: Draws up dark energy to deal deadly damage to enemies from the explosion. Explosion damage will be applied as 100% critical attack.

skills.name: Demon Impact
skills.description: Call forth your inner demon to deal critical damage to multiple enemies in front of you. Your channel to the nether gives you a chance to ignore Enemy DEF and raises your chance for a critical and a Slow effect. Damage increases when fighting bosses.

skills.name: Leech Aura
skills.description: You and your party members will receive health for every blow you inflict for a short time.

skills.name: Demon Cry
skills.description: Releases your inner demons to intimidate and deal damage on multiple nearby enemies. Inflicts Blind and a decrease to DEF, ATT, and Accuracy to enemies while increasing your EXP and item drop rate.

skills.name: Maple Warrior
skills.description: The Goddess of Tynerum's protection increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Goddess of Tynerum appear.

skills.name: Dark Metamorphosis
skills.description: Enshroud yourself with 2 spectral shadows which lash out at nearby enemies, and increase damage.\nDark Metamorphosis is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Binding Darkness
skills.description: Chance to knock down multiple enemies. Also ignores a fixed amount of enemy DEF. The effects of Binding Darkness apply to both bosses and regular monsters.\nEnemies hit by this will resist stuns for 90 seconds and won't be stunned by other skills, such as Binding Darkness, either.

skills.name: Boundless Rage
skills.description: Consumes all remaining Fury to send yourself into a berserk rage. All Fury-based attacks will be free for a short period, but this skill has a long cooldown.

skills.name: Infernal Concussion
skills.description: Calls an eruption from below to blast nearby enemies into the air. Enemies in air receive 100% critical damage from the explosion.

skills.name: The Demon's Will
skills.description: Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Not affected by Combat Orders.\nCan be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Cerberus Chomp
skills.description: Utilize the power of the nether world to damage enemies and rob them of their souls.

skills.name: Demonic Fortitude
skills.description: Calls upon demonic power to bolster your spirit.

skills.name: Blue Blood
skills.description: Awaken your latent royal blood. Not applied to Summon, 5th Job Common, or certain other skills.

skills.name: Demon Awakening
skills.description: Awakens your true power. The Cerberus portion is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Spirit of Rage
skills.description: Sacrifice all your Fury to conjure a malevolent serpent of pure rage. Attacks again before vanishing. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Impenetrable Skin
skills.description: Makes your flesh as strong as steel so you're not pushed back by enemy attacks.

skills.name: Orthrus
skills.description: Sacrifice all your Fury to summon malevolent twin gods of pure rage. The twin gods' attacks are unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Demon Bane
skills.description: Erupt with overwhelming destructive force and become invincible. When used while Demon Awakening is active, the awakened force is unleashed and increases its power.\nWhen you stop holding the skill key, the force will surround you, allowing you to deal a more powerful attack. To cancel the final attack, use the skill again while holding the down arrow key.

skills.name: Demon Bane
skills.description: Surround oneself in a force field and destroy enemies while in an invincible state.

skills.name: Demonic Plume
skills.description: The noble lineage gains form and deals a powerful attack on nearby enemies. When attacking a large number of enemies, boss monsters with max HP are looked for and attacked first.\nWhen casting Nightmare, cooldown is reset once, and cooldown decreases during Nightmare.\nUnaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: HEXA Demon Impact
skills.description: Release the power of the Demon to deal critical damage to multiple enemies in front of you. The Fury released when the power of the Demon is temporarily pushed to its limit becomes a demon chain that devastates the enemy.

skills.name: HEXA Demon Impact: Demon Chain
skills.description: The Fury released when the power of the Demon is temporarily pushed to its limit becomes a demon chain that devastates its surroundings. The enemy is weakened and a large amount of Fury can be restored. The Demon Chain debuff does not stack with the Demon Cry debuff.

skills.name: HEXA Demon Lash
skills.description:
Mash the attack key to perform a series of attacks on the enemy. Hits return some Fury to you.
When using Demon Lash or Demon Impact, periodically a rush of demonic power bursts forth, activating Demonic Spear that sweeps enemies away. During Demon Awakening, Demonic Spear is enhanced.
The first, second, and final enhancement effects of Demon Lash are applied to HEXA Demon Lash and Demonic Spear.
Additionally, enhances Demon Lash while Demon Awakening is active.

skills.name: Demonic Spear
skills.description: Latent demonic power bursts forth and and sweeps away enemies.

skills.name: HEXA Infernal Concussion
skills.description: Draw up dark energy and detonate it. Permanently enhances HEXA Demon Impact.

skills.name: HEXA Dark Metamorphosis
skills.description: Temporarily unleash the demonic power to the extreme and mark enemies within a certain range with Demon Markings. When a direct skill attack lands on an enemy with Demon Markings, a powerful evil deals additional attacks. In addition, it permanently boosts HEXA Demon Impact.\nHEXA Dark Metamorphosis's evil attack is unaffected by Blue Blood effect.\nIncreases Buff Duration. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: HEXA Demon Cry
skills.description: Release your inner demons to intimidate and deal damage on multiple nearby enemies. Inflicts Blind and a decrease to DEF, Attack Power, and Accuracy to enemies while increasing your EXP and item drop rate. Also permanently enhances HEXA Demon Impact: Demon Chain.

skills.name: HEXA Cerberus Chomp
skills.description: With the power of the nether world, punish the enemies in front and rob their souls. The power of the nether world periodically awakens to change its appearance to HEXA Cerberus Chomp: Teeth of Tartarus and swallows up everything around it.\nHEXA Cerberus Chomp doesn't change during Demon Awakening, and the automatically triggered Cerberus Chomp changes to HEXA Cerberus Chomp: Teeth of Tartarus.

skills.name: HEXA Cerberus Chomp: Teeth of Tartarus
skills.description: The power of the nether world fully awakens and swallows up everything around it. Shares cooldown with HEXA Cerberus Chomp.\nAutomatically triggered Cerberus Chomp changes to HEXA Cerberus Chomp: Tarterian Cerberus Chomp during Demon Awakening.

skills.name: Nightmare
skills.description:
The roiling Demon Fury plunges your surroundings into a demonic abyss. All attacks from the Demon will temporarily unleash an additional attack with the Flames of the Netherworld, and you can gain Demon Fury beyond the max limit.
Using the skill again will condense all the Fury into a huge weapon to deal a powerful blow. This powerful strike can be used during Demon Lash and Demon Impact.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +20%
Lv. 20 - Boss Damage: +20%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +30%, Boss Damage: +30%

skills.name: Nightmare
skills.description: The roiling Demon Fury plunges your surroundings into a demonic abyss. All attacks from the Demon will temporarily unleash an additional attack with the Flames of the Netherworld, and you can gain Demon Fury beyond the max limit.\nUsing the skill again will condense all the Fury into a huge weapon to deal a powerful blow. This powerful strike can be used during Demon Lash and Demon Impact.
